definitions.gloss: allocation of marks; point distribution; scoring
definitions.explanation: The way points or marks are distributed across questions or sections of a test, exam, or competition. Also refers to the specific number of points assigned to a particular question.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{配点|はいてん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧。
examples.english: This question is worth a lot of points.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{配点|はいてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}して→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{勉強|べんきょう}する→勉強する：00527_benkyousuru⟧。
examples.english: I check the point allocation of the exam before studying.

examples.japanese: ⟦{記述|きじゅつ}→記述：05819_kijutsu⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{配点|はいてん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{全体|ぜんたい}→全体：03314_zentai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{半分|はんぶん}→半分：02938_hanbun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{占|し}めている→占める：11799_shimeru⟧。
examples.english: The essay questions account for half of the total marks.

notes:
A term frequently encountered in educational settings, particularly when discussing exams and tests. Essential vocabulary for anyone studying or taking exams in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {配点|はいてん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧: worth many points
- {配点|はいてん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧: worth few points
- {配点|はいてん}⟦{比率|ひりつ}→比率：06727_hiritsu⟧: point allocation ratio
- {配点|はいてん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧: to check the point distribution
- {各問|かくもん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{配点|はいてん}: the points for each question

USAGE:
Students commonly use this word when strategizing which sections of a test to focus on. A question with higher {配点|はいてん} deserves more study time. Also used in competitions and judging to describe how points are assigned to different criteria.

ETYMOLOGY:
{配|はい} (distribute, allocate) + ⟦{点|てん}→点：01553_ten⟧ (point, mark).
